scope: Interpretation of atomic_feedback_D5.json and atomic_feedback.json; numerical receipts and their source pins are unchanged.
radiative_Halpha_up_cm3_s: Sum of n_lower times the self-eliminated effective pump_up_s. This positive contribution to the rearranged rate operator is not the physical gross absorption computed from full transported J.
radiative_Halpha_down_cm3_s: Sum of n_upper times the corresponding effective radiative_down_s. Their difference is the net H-alpha contribution to n=3.
collisional_to_effective_radiative_ratio: The small ratio of upward collision rate to effective upward radiative rate does not by itself exclude collisional control of a net balance, because upward and downward contributions may cancel. Departure of the actual n3/n2 from its same-temperature LTE value is a separate direct diagnostic.
effective_spontaneous_over_A: (radiative_down_s - stimulated_down_s) / A is the own-branch source-elimination factor. It is neither global photon escape nor an irreversible photon-destruction probability.
causal_scope: Full J, populations, temperature, charge and flow all change together. These saved-root comparisons do not isolate one causal mechanism. Bound-free entries include receiving packets but are selected channels, not a complete chemical source attribution.

same_temperature_LTE_check.calculation: b = atom.statistical_weights * exp(-atom.excitation_energy_erg / (1.380649e-16 * T)); LTE_n3_over_n2 = sum(b[3:6]) / sum(b[1:3])
